verdict.rationale: The Agent API documents MCP-client support in its tools: you attach "your own remote MCP server" and "the model discovers and calls the server's tools" (docs-49), alongside the built-in tools (docs-30). That is exactly the plug-in-MCP-servers capability, though it rests on a single doc line. The many Perplexity MCP *server* items describe the opposite role and are not credited here. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuration, auth, and tool filtering for attached servers; any local/stdio server support (only remote is documented); independent or hands-on corroboration.
